people.name: Pha bong kha pa dbe chen snying po

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: Here, under master Cigu (慈顧; d.u.) - most probably the same Jiangba gege ... mentioned by Nenghai ... - Fazun continued his language training but was also able to begin the study of the texts of the Gelukpa tradition.

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: They stayed for another two years in the local Drakkar Monastery ... where they studied under the elder Dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags (1866-1928, Drakkar Lama) and his disciples.

relations.subject: Dayong
relations.evidence: They stayed for another two years in the local Drakkar Monastery ... where they studied under the elder Dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags (1866-1928, Drakkar Lama) and his disciples.

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: in 1931 reached Chamdo ... to study under Amdo Geshe, from whom he received about 40 tantric initiations and many teachings.

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: He was admitted at the Drepung Monastery (Tib. 'Bras spungs dgon pa), where he resided for two years. There, Fazun studied with Amdo Geshe and with other renowned masters

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.object: Pha bong kha pa dbe chen snying po
relations.evidence: He also received teachings and initiations from the famous Pha bong kha pa dbe chen snying po (1878-1941).

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: In 1934, Taixu asked Fazun to return to China to direct the newly founded Sino-Tibetan Buddhist Institute in the Jinyun Monastery (縉雲寺) near Chongqing... As director of the Sino-Tibetan Institute...

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: He then spent a few more months in Lhasa, where he was able to study under the Dharma Master Byang rtse chos rje (Jiangze fawang [絳則法王]; d.u.) at Ganden Monastery.

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: As soon as the Chongqing Institute was closed down in 1950, he was summoned to Beijing and was employed as a translator for the Committee for Minority Affairs

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: in 1956 he was nominated vice president of the Chinese Institute for Buddhist Studies (Zhongguo Foxue yuan [中國佛學院]).

relations.subject: Fazun
relations.evidence: He was then chosen to be the president of the Chinese Institute for Buddhist Studies, which had just reopened, a position he kept until his death.
